title: encyclia trulla
intro: Encyclia trulla, commonly known as the helmet orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Encyclia trulla include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as a sedative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
